command: C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "`$p='CampusNetwork_02'; `$items=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri ('http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/'+`$p+'/nodes') -Method Get; foreach(`$dev in `$items){`$c='display current-configuration'; `$u='http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/'+`$p+'/nodes/'+`$dev.node_id+'/command?cmd='+[uri]::EscapeDataString(`$c); `$r=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri `$u -Method Get; `$hits=`$r.output -split '\r?\n' | Where-Object {`$_ -match '160\.0\.0\.1|160\.0\.0\.'}; if(`$hits){Write-Output ('### '+`$dev.name); Write-Output `$hits}}"
